modules.rationale: K9 consumer projection over the already-owned AW1/Bimba, K8 M1–M3 continuous field, #134 Nara and QL/Factory Vāk performance contracts. It owns selection/focus/presentation currentness and routes deliberate operations back through the existing session; it creates no graph store, numerical field, clock, renderer, authority system or AgentSession.

Thin K9 admission join from AW1's accepted RootedMWorld into the focused selection carrier. Source, revision, Bimba face and relation identities are received from AW1 rather than re-derived; no second M registry or Bimba graph is introduced.

Thin K9 consumer of the accepted #94/#183 ql.operative-scope-currentness/v1 owner response. It validates QL provider/owner/interpretation identity and preserves Current/Stale/Missing for presentation consumers without reobserving C-prime state, granting authority or defining another coordinate/scope registry.

Bounded controlled-host transport over one PersonalCoupledSession and one FocusedInstrument. It resolves configured source selections through AW1 and serialises K9 commands/receipts, while all numerical, personal, Bimba and Vāk semantics remain in their existing owners.

K9 browser transport/presentation driver for one already-authorised ql-focused-host. Focus/Bimba/clock requests and continuous native advances share one exact host sequence; accepted K8 NativeAudioBinding and RetainedFieldBinding receive the same acknowledged field while O:I supplies only its existing retained stage lease. Explicit source-qualified sample correspondence is required. The adapter creates no numerical owner, renderer, clock, graph, executable authority or AgentSession.

QL #204 completes the existing L5.3 Geometry/constellation morphology, with M1 retaining the formal Spanda/QL owner while the canonical Second-Spanda body consumes the already-owned M2 six-by-six and M3 three-site fold body. The module adds shape/compression carriers and projections only; it creates no new M coordinates or competing geometry ontology. Canonical architecture: docs/geometry/CANONICAL-CONSTELLATION-RESOLUTION.md.

QL #222 is the inverse lookup seam for the already-owned L5.3 Geometry shapes. It resolves only exact canonical versioned refs produced by QlShape::shape_ref, rejects aliases and anonymous Other grains, and introduces no new shape, coordinate or semantic authority.

QL #206 restores the already-authored Second-Spanda equation as one executable M1 formal reading of the existing M2 6^2 field and M3 4^3=2^6 body, including the derived decadic Geometry projection. It does not relocate M2/M3 numerical ownership or create a second Spanda source. Canonical architecture: docs/geometry/CANONICAL-CONSTELLATION-RESOLUTION.md.

QL #207 extends the existing Vāk/C-prime composition owner so a kernel-validated 2/3-fold disclosure may present as the one-fold 0/1 while retaining the actual member body, basis, operator and derivation. Recursive composition still acts on the disclosed constellation and explicit member focus reopens it; no second shape, Wiki or Vāk schema is introduced. Canonical architecture: docs/geometry/CANONICAL-CONSTELLATION-RESOLUTION.md.

QL #222 is a transport/projection consumer of the existing ShapeBinding and Wiki refraction contracts. It validates canonical ql-core shape refs and compression metadata, carries that view through Wiki readings, and deliberately leaves ParticipationForm, Geometry semantics, source relations and provider execution in their existing owners.
